title: EstimationRecord
description: A single estimation data point comparing original estimate to actual effort, optionally including AI-assisted development metrics.

team_size.description: Number of people who worked on the task

tool_calls.description: Number of tool calls if AI-assisted

reasoning_depth.description: Qualitative reasoning depth used during estimation

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the estimate was made

contributor_id.description: Anonymized contributor hash (NOT email or name)

estimate_basis_version.description: Optional basis-era label (ticket 11, estimate-basis unification). 1 = legacy row (pre-unification: tools displayed an adjusted value the ledger did not record); 2 = post-unification row (displayed estimate == recorded estimate). estimated_hours is ALWAYS the ledger-recorded basis in both eras; this label lets consumers keep v1/v2 ratio populations split. Absent = unknown/legacy.
